answers.answer: Since AB is a diameter, $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$, so $m(\angle ABC) = 90^\circ - m(\angle CAB)$. In right triangle ABX (BX tangent, so $\angle ABX = 90^\circ$), $m(\angle X) = 90^\circ - m(\angle CAB)$. So $m(\angle X) = m(\angle ABC)$. ABCD is cyclic, so $m(\angle ABC) + m(\angle ADC) = 180^\circ$, i.e. the exterior angle $\angle CDY$ at D equals $\angle ABC$. Hence the exterior angle at D equals the interior opposite angle at X, so XYDC is cyclic.
